2609.30993.title: FLIP: Final Layer Inference-Time Probing for Vision-Language Models
2609.30993.paper_summary: We present FLIP, a final-layer inference-time probe for testing whether a logit-facing intervention site in an open-weight vision-language model (VLM) supports structured, task-linked computation rather than generic perturbation. Behavioral change under internal intervention is otherwise mechanistically ambiguous: it may reflect improved use of visual evidence, generic output instability, or outright degradation. FLIP applies elementwise flooring to the final normalized hidden state before logit computation, leaving parameters, prompts, and decoding unchanged. On a controlled detection/counting probe, sweeping intervention strength reveals three regions: negligible change, a bounded interior regime in which detection recall at IoU 0.50 ($R_{50}$) improves while tolerant counting error ($\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{count}}$) falls, and over-suppression. We formalize a four-criterion probe-and-sweep protocol for disciplining the interpretation of intervention effects: regime structure, grounding-proxy alignment, feature-coherence dependence, and failure to reproduce the same positive regime on a performance-based negative control. The post-normalization state passed to the output head is the logit-facing instantiation of this test; under a non-targeted flooring sweep it satisfies the full protocol. Raw decoder-layer interventions, including the last-block output before final normalization, and the singleton-pair left/right control fail to reproduce the Final-site signature, while same-site operators and multiple VLMs replicate it. FLIP is therefore a validation step for intervention-based mechanistic interpretability, not a steering method.
2609.30993.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了FLIP，一種最終層推理時間探針，用於測試開放權重視覺-語言模型（VLM）中的邏輯介入位置是否支持結構化的、與任務相關的計算，而不是通用的擾動。內部介入下的行為變化在機制上是模糊的：它可能反映出視覺證據的改進使用、通用輸出不穩定性或明顯的退化。FLIP在邏輯計算之前對最終的標準化隱藏狀態進行逐元素的下限處理，保持參數、提示和解碼不變。在一個受控的檢測/計數探針中，掃描介入強度揭示了三個區域：微不足道的變化、一個有界的內部範疇，在這個範疇中，IoU 0.50（$R_{50}$）的檢測召回率提高，而容忍的計數誤差（$\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{count}}$）下降，以及過度抑制。我們正式化了一個四項標準的探針和掃描協議，以規範對介入效果的解釋：範疇結構、基礎代理對齊、特徵一致性依賴性，以及未能在基於性能的負控制中重現相同的正範疇。傳遞給輸出頭的後標準化狀態是這個測試的邏輯面向實例；在非目標的下限掃描下，它滿足完整的協議。原始解碼器層介入，包括最終標準化之前的最後區塊輸出，以及單一對左/右控制未能重現最終位置簽名，而同位置操作符和多個VLM則能夠複製它。因此，FLIP是基於介入的機制可解釋性的驗證步驟，而不是一種引導方法。
